Container.Name: igab-backup
Container.Overview: IGAB backup agent — periodic pg_dump of the IGAB database plus attachment archives, with retention pruning and optional age encryption. Backup schedule/retention/encryption are configured in the IGAB app (Settings -> Backups) and picked up live; the env vars here are only fallbacks. Financial data with no backup story is a demo, not a system of record. See https://github.com/brentonmallen1/IGAB/blob/main/docs/unraid.md for full setup.

Config.Name: Postgres Host
Config.Description: Hostname of the PostgreSQL container on the igab network.

Config.Name: Postgres User
Config.Description: Database user (must match the postgres container).

Config.Name: Postgres Password
Config.Description: Database password (must match the postgres container).

Config.Name: Backup Interval Hours
Config.Description: Fallback only - hours between backups when the app's Settings -> Backups values are unreadable.

Config.Name: Backup Keep Days
Config.Description: Fallback only - prune backups older than this many days.

Config.Name: Backup Keep Min
Config.Description: Fallback only - always keep at least this many newest files per kind, however old.

Config.Name: Age Recipient
Config.Description: Optional - age public key (age1...). When set, dumps and archives are encrypted to it. Keep the private key OFF this server. Also configurable in-app.

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Backup destination - MUST be the same folder as the igab-api container's Backups path (the app lists/restores through it). Point at the array, not the postgres data pool.

Config.Name: Attachments (read-only)
Config.Description: The igab-api attachments folder, mounted read-only so attachment archives are included in backups.
